def compute_max_radii_iterative(centers):
    """Compute maximum radii using iterative approach."""
    n = centers.shape[0]
    
    # Start with wall distances
    radii = np.zeros(n)
    for i in range(n):
        x, y = centers[i]
        radii[i] = min(x, y, 1 - x, 1 - y)
    
    # Iteratively enforce non-overlap constraints
    for iteration in range(50):
        changed = False
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                dist = np.linalg.norm(centers[i] - centers[j])
                overlap = radii[i] + radii[j] - dist
                if overlap > 1e-12:
                    # Shrink both proportionally
                    factor = dist / (radii[i] + radii[j])
                    radii[i] *= factor
                    radii[j] *= factor
                    changed = True
        if not changed:
            break
    
    return radii


def local_optimize(centers, radii, iterations=200):
    """Locally optimize center positions to maximize sum of radii."""
    n = len(centers)
    best_sum = np.sum(radii)
    best_centers = centers.copy()
    best_radii = radii.copy()

                s = np.sum(new_radii)

                    best_sum = s
                    best_centers = new_centers.copy()
                    best_radii = new_radii.copy()
        step *= 0.97
    
    return best_centers, best_radii
